extension.description: Torrest is a service with a rest API which allows torrent streaming.
extension.news: - [0.0.32] Fully downloaded files play straight from disk instead of through the daemon, so seeking no longer stalls - [0.0.31] Torrent manager: a paused torrent resumes on Download or play, and shows no stale speeds; a video plays as any play does (buffered, with the loading screen); Play files with: Torrest or Ultra Player; torrents listed last added first, their files by name; the index (Torrents, Settings) is back - [0.0.30] Torrent manager: Torrest opens straight to a live table of its torrents (size, done, status, speeds, seeds, peers), whose rows expand in place to their files; Add torrent/magnet dialog redrawn at 1080i in the same colours - [0.0.29] Videos folder for other add-ons (a pack's episodes); quiet downloads (silent); stop on exit leaves a torrent downloading ahead running; Keep packs (on): the stop action never deletes a pack; Delete watched episodes from packs (off): deletes just the watched episode's file - [0.0.28] Pauses when the download falls behind playback and carries on once Resume once ahead by is ready (Player settings); publishes the ready range for skin.ultra's progress line - [0.0.27] Settings sorted into categories (Player, Deletion, Timeouts, Torrent, Logging) with help text on the timeouts; buffering, metadata and piece wait limits each have an on/off toggle; the unused buffer size setting is hidden - [0.0.26] Delete action setting (Ask by default, so a deletion can be refused); a torrent played again is kept, not paused or deleted by the earlier play; the loading screen left with Back stops the play; a downloaded file plays without buffering; the torrent list waits for the daemon to start - [0.0.25] Cancels when the skin's loading screen is left with Back, even before a play starts, and never starts an already buffered play after it - [0.0.24] webOS: a soft-float daemon build for LG TVs (upstream's armv7 one can't run there), and a clear message instead of a crash when the daemon can't run on a device - [0.0.23] download_magnet: download a torrent, or one of its files, without playing it (for Ultra Player's Download) - Update torrest binary to v0.0.8 - Add proper info to the play list item
